1, 2 & 3 Bedroom Homes

Westgate Village Apartments offers 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments in Malvern, Pennsylvania. Each home was designed with your lifestyle in mind, so you can always start your day on the right foot. Thoughtful features like private entrances and spacious floor plans elevate the space, making it the ideal spot to call home. Take a look at our cat-friendly layouts to see which one fits your needs.

YOUR SPACE

Floor Plans That Floor You

Find your space to live your way. Host a game night, indulge in a night of solo self-care, or cook up an epic meal. If you’ve been looking for the perfect place to call home in Malvern, Pennsylvania, Westgate Village Apartments has an apartment for you – and the whole crew!

See a floor plan that speaks to you? Reach out to our friendly leasing team to schedule an in-person tour today. We can’t wait to show you around!

Studio, 1, & 2 Bedroom Homes

The Village at Voorhees offers Studio, 1, & 2 bedroom apartments in Voorhees, New Jersey. Each home was designed with your lifestyle in mind, so you can always start your day on the right foot. Thoughtful features like a washer & dryer and spacious rooms elevate the space, making it the ideal spot to call home. Take a look at our pet-friendly layouts to see which one fits your needs.

YOUR SPACE

Floor Plans That Floor You

Find your space to live your way. Host a game night, indulge in a night of solo self-care, or cook up an epic meal. If you’ve been looking for the perfect place to call home in Voorhees, New Jersey, The Village at Voorhees has an apartment for you – and the whole crew!

See a floor plan that speaks to you? Schedule your in-person or self-guided tour today. We can’t wait to show you around!

All corporate partners receive $250 off first month's rent. Our partners include -- 

American Water, Aramark, Comcast/Cognizant, Campbell Soup, Lockheed Martin, NFI Industries, Pine Valley Golf Club, Rowan University and all its affiliates, South Jersey Gas, Subaru Corporation, U.S. Cold Storage.

Full time students.
